The reason is that the pivot disc S.disc(6, 2) and the 2 mm strip that starts at the pivot (model lines 199-206) sample the same area twice. At the other plates' median 0.342 per mm2 the ear would carry about 30 samples, and in-band would be about 0.8955 bench (gap about 19.03) and 0.8940 held (about 23.37). That is an arithmetic estimate, not a re-wear. It equals the leader's 0.8955 (remeasure/slipper-nose-knuckle-3r_bench.json): the row's in-band edge over the leader is the ear's excess sampling.
